treatmentJourney.title: Consultation And 3D Scan
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation and a state-of-the-art 3D iTero scan, allowing you to preview your potential new smile even before treatment starts.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Plan & Aligner Manufacturing
treatmentJourney.description: Based on your scan, a personalized treatment plan is created, and your custom series of clear Invisalign aligners are meticulously manufactured just for you.

treatmentJourney.title: First Aligners & Coaching
treatmentJourney.description: You'll receive your first set of aligners along with comprehensive coaching on how to wear, care for, and maintain them for optimal results.

treatmentJourney.title: Regular Progress Check-ins
treatmentJourney.description: We'll schedule periodic check-ins every 6-10 weeks to closely monitor your tooth movement and ensure your treatment is progressing as planned.

treatmentJourney.title: Refinement Aligners (If Needed)
treatmentJourney.description: Towards the end of your treatment, if necessary, refinement aligners may be provided to achieve any final fine-tuning for that perfect smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Retainers & Smile Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: Upon completion, custom retainers are provided to maintain your beautiful new smile, along with guidance for long-term smile maintenance.

implantOptions.title: Invisalign Comprehensive
implantOptions.description: Full-treatment clear aligners for adults addressing crowding, spacing, or bite correction, typically completed within 12-18 months.

implantOptions.title: Invisalign Teen
implantOptions.description: Aligners designed specifically for growing smiles, complete with compliance indicators and replacement aligners for active teen lifestyles.

implantOptions.title: Invisalign Express
implantOptions.description: A shorter aligner treatment, often 3-6 months, ideal for minor crowding, correcting relapse from previous orthodontics, or pre-cosmetic alignment.

implantOptions.title: Retention & Whitening
implantOptions.description: Custom retainers are provided to protect your newly straightened smile, with optional whitening treatments that pair perfectly with your clear aligner trays.

faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign treatment typically take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of Invisalign treatment varies based on the complexity of your case, but many patients complete their journey within 12 to 18 months, often faster than traditional braces.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: The cost of Invisalign depends on individual needs. We recommend a consultation to discuss pricing. Many dental insurance plans offer coverage for orthodontic treatment, including Invisalign.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I need to wear my Invisalign aligners?
faqItems.answer: For optimal results, it is recommended to wear your Invisalign aligners for 20 to 22 hours per day, removing them only for eating, drinking, brushing, and flossing.

faqItems.question: Can Invisalign fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign can effectively treat a wide range of orthodontic issues, including overbites, underbites, crossbites, and open bites. A comprehensive evaluation with Dr. Sher will determine the best course of action for your smile.

faqItems.question: Will Invisalign hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: You may experience some mild discomfort when switching to new aligners, which typically subsides quickly. While there might be a slight adjustment period for speech, most patients adapt very quickly.

faqItems.question: What happens after Invisalign treatment, do I need a retainer?
faqItems.answer: Yes, after completing your Invisalign treatment, wearing a retainer is crucial to maintain your new smile and prevent teeth from shifting back to their original positions. We will discuss your retention options with you.

doctor.name: Michael Sher
doctor.bio: Dr. Michael Sher, the son of a dentist, trained at the prestigious University of Pennsylvania School of Dental Medicine and completed his postdoctoral training in Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics at the University of Detroit Mercy Dental School. His focus on cutting-edge tools and techniques, including 3D X-Rays, has helped countless patients achieve beautiful smiles with both braces and Invisalign treatment. Dr. Sher is a Board Certified Orthodontist and has earned the status of "Gold Provider" by Invisalign, reflecting his commitment to providing the highest level of patient care. He is happily married to Dr. Deena Sher, and they have three beautiful children.
